scope: Selected B1 only: small rosemary and sand ceramic pot on left sill, 3mm cork under the existing mug. No publication, camera changes, new lighting or dependencies.

method.runtime: Shared Node 24.14.0, existing Playwright, system Chrome 156.0.8078.80, ANGLE Metal Apple M1 Pro; no installation or isolated environment.
method.script: Unchanged scripts/measure-performance.mjs via local measure.mjs, development server 5173. DPR1, CPU1x, reduced motion, clear simulated weather, no birds/vessels, default warm 50% room light.
method.dayNight: 1280x800, ordinary quality, fixed scene time 2026-10-31 12:00 / 22:00. Each before/after group contains three serial five-second samples.
method.phone: 390x844, low quality, fixed scene time 2026-10-31 22:00, one five-second sample before and after; desktop browser size emulation, not a physical phone.
method.isolation: GPU QA and sample groups ran serially, source frozen in each sample group. Temporary caffeinate used to prevent idle system sleep.
method.limits: Refresh-limited short samples do not prove speedup or net GPU cost. CPU submission is not GPU completion. No Safari, physical phone, battery, thermal or GPU memory validation.

resourceChanges.description: Three merged opaque plant meshes and one cork mesh. Vertex colors, no textures or transparent layers, no per-frame updates. The scene aggregate owns disposal. Both manual shadow variants warm once as in the existing renderer; repeated quality switches reuse them.

initialTests.reason: New test incorrectly assumed that the first manual shadow-quality switch never compiles existing shader variants. Corrected to keep geometry/texture invariant and verify complete program reuse after both variants render. Product code unchanged for this correction.

validation.build: Explicit final typecheck and production build passed; existing Three.js large-chunk warning retained.
validation.sourceFixes: A coaster profile tuple annotation was required by TypeScript before first tests. Coaster surface winding was checked/fixed before first tests.
